name: Binary Search
code:
arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
target = 4
left = 0
right = len(arr) - 1
result = -1
while left <= right:
    mid = (left + right) // 2
    if arr[mid] == target:
        result = mid
        break
    elif arr[mid] < target:
        left = mid + 1
    else:
        right = mid - 1
final = result
